viewerQuestion: Same price, different parts. What does this comparison page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I can apply a repeatable check to any comparison page and know when its numbers are too close to act on.

beats.narration: Here is a short check you can run on any comparison page, starting with the page in front of you.
First, write down what would actually answer your question, before you look for the bigger number.
On this comparison every per-game difference is smaller than the range SpecSmith's model declares for its own estimates, so the model does not separate them on frame rate. These are model estimates.
beats.onScreenText: Read the range, not just the value

beats.narration: Then name what is still unsettled. Here that is everything outside frame rate, and this page does not cover it.
Run that check on the comparison you actually care about.
